anchors.paper_title: Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces: Random Forests Vs Regularized Lda - Non-Linear Beats Linear
anchors.paper_venue: TUGraz OPEN Library (Graz University of Technology)
anchors.reason: Same authors re-analyse the RF-driven SMR BCI data with CSP features, but it is an offline method comparison, not the dataset's own data descriptor; the primary paper is the DOI 10.1007/s00500-012-0895-4 study.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with g.USBamp amplifiers and active Ag/AgCl electrodes (g.LADYbird cap) at 512 Hz, referenced to the left mastoid and grounded at the right mastoid, using BCI2000. Data were online filtered with 8th-order Butterworth band-pass filters. Each session comprised recording, training and feedback phases with 80 trials each of right-hand and feet motor imagery, 5 s per trial.
